## Change

Describe the change and the PRD requirement or roadmap task it supports.

## Verification

Describe the checks performed and their results, or explain why none apply.

## Evidence and limitations

Link relevant permitted evidence and identify incomplete or unvalidated behavior.

## Repository guidance

- [ ] I read AGENTS.md and, if I used a coding agent, verified that it loaded the applicable guidance.
- [ ] The change stays within the linked task's authorized scope and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Commits use conventional subjects and each has one clear purpose.
